name: compact_plant_pot
code: const wall = p.wall; const r = p.potDiameter / 2; const h = p.potHeight; const clearance = 0.5; const holeR = 3; const saucerH = 10; const saucerR = r + wall + 2; const potBase = drawCircle(r).sketchOnPlane('XY').extrude(h); const potInner = drawCircle(r - wall).sketchOnPlane('XY', [0, 0, wall]).extrude(h); let pot = potBase.cut(potInner); for(let i = 0; i < p.drainageCount; i++) { const angle = (i / p.drainageCount) * 2 * Math.PI; const hx = (r / 2) * Math.cos(angle); const hy = (r / 2) * Math.sin(angle); const hole = makeCylinder(holeR, wall + 1, [hx, hy, 0], [0, 0, 1]); pot = pot.cut(hole); } const saucerBase = drawCircle(saucerR).sketchOnPlane('XY', [0, 0, -saucerH - 2]).extrude(saucerH); const saucerVoid = drawCircle(r + clearance).sketchOnPlane('XY', [0, 0, -saucerH - 2 + (wall * 0.75)]).extrude(saucerH); const saucer = saucerBase.cut(saucerVoid); return { pot: pot, saucer: saucer };
